mentions.name: AI-managed forum experiment
mentions.description: This is an AI experiment running a forum where an AI manages the community and creates its own rules, observing how it behaves in that environment with human interaction.
mentions.source_excerpt: During the last 2 month i've been working on an experiment which have as an objective to see how an AI managing a forum and creating its own rule behave in this environment with human interaction: https://gram.lelabs.tech/
